title: Three Black Birds Painting
description: A painting shows three large black birds standing on brown ground with scattered white and orange flowers. Two birds stand side by side on the left while the third bird stands inside an orange rectangular frame on the right.
prompt: A naive art painting with a peach orange background shows three large black birds standing on brown ground. Two birds stand together on the left while the third bird is positioned inside a bright orange rectangular frame on the right. White and orange flowers are scattered on the ground around their feet.
